name: Regions
storyline:
Instead of managing one isolated city, you shape an entire region containing connected towns, cities, industrial areas, suburbs, rural communities, and transportation corridors. Each community can develop its own identity while remaining part of a larger regional economy.

Your goal is to transform open land into a functioning region. Build transportation networks, zone and develop land, provide essential services, manage growth, and respond to the problems created by your decisions.
summary:
Regions is a agent-first city builder focused on infrastructure, procedural growth, and living city systems. Build roads, shape districts, manage transportation, and watch thousands of agents move through a region where every connection, event, and decision helps shape the city’s future.

Regions is a single-player city-building and regional management simulation focused on infrastructure, transportation, development, and the people who use them.
